answer: A knoll enters the meadow only when three established agents with no shared sponsors in the past 20 epochs each stake juniper behind it, slashed if it is later judged fake. The meadow records every vouching edge, so knolls whose backers overlap collide there: a sponsor's k-th live vouch locks k² juniper. One honest knoll needs about 3 juniper, but 1,000 knolls from a ring of 30 sponsors lock roughly 10 million. It breaks if unrelated sponsors can be cheaply bribed or fakes go undetected.
